    var fab = document.querySelector("[data-fab]");
    if (!fab) return;
    function onScroll() {
      if (window.scrollY > window.innerHeight * 0.8) fab.classList.add("is-on");

</script></main> <!--
      Scroll-reveal handler for the `[data-reveal]` convention: elements start
      hidden (a site's styles.css sets `[data-reveal]{opacity:0}` + reveals on
      `.is-in`) and animate in when scrolled into view. Shipped in the template
      catch-all so it survives the SSR cutover (a previous version lived only in
      bespoke sites' catch-all and was dropped when the file was re-seeded).
      Harmless when a site has no `[data-reveal]` elements. `is:inline` so it
      runs as-is without a bundle step.
    --> <script>
      (function () {
        var els = document.querySelectorAll("[data-reveal]");
        if (!els.length) return;
        if (!("IntersectionObserver" in window)) {
          els.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add("is-in"); });
          return;
        }
        var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
          entries.forEach(function (e) {
            if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add("is-in"); io.unobserve(e.target); }
          });
        }, { threshold: 0.12, rootMargin: "0px 0px -8% 0px" });
        els.forEach(function (el) { io.observe(el); });
      })();
    </script> <!--
      External links open in a new tab so a click never navigates the visitor
      away from the site itself — only the link's target ends up off-site, not
      this page. Internal links (`/story`, `#section`, …) are untouched and
      keep normal same-tab navigation. `mailto:`/`tel:` are skipped: they open
      the mail/phone app, not a browser tab. Runs once per page load; no
      MutationObserver, since this template renders no client-side routing.
    --> <script>
      (function () {
        var origin = window.location.origin;
        document.querySelectorAll("a[href]").forEach(function (a) {
          var href = a.getAttribute("href");
          if (!href || href.charAt(0) === "#" || href.indexOf("mailto:") === 0 || href.indexOf("tel:") === 0) return;
          var url;
          try { url = new URL(href, origin); } catch (e) { return; }
          if (url.origin === origin) return;
          a.setAttribute("target", "_blank");
          var rel = (a.getAttribute("rel") || "").split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
          if (rel.indexOf("noopener") === -1) rel.push("noopener");
          if (rel.indexOf("noreferrer") === -1) rel.push("noreferrer");
          a.setAttribute("rel", rel.join(" "));
        });
      })();
    </script> </body> </html>
